name: Bounty or Booty
source:
Ever wanted to date a pirate? Well, here's your chance!

Follow the protagonist, an experienced bounty hunter, as she decides to join a pirate crew undercover to capture the Captain and get the bounty on his head. Unfortunately for her, there's a bit of a hole in her plan: the pirates are cute. Like HOT.  

[From [url=https://doksa.itch.io/bounty-or-booty]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
曾经想和海盗约会吗？好吧，你的机会来了！

跟随主角，一位经验丰富的赏金猎人，她决定加入一个卧底海盗团伙，抓捕船长并获取他的人头。对她来说不幸的是，她的计划有一点漏洞：海盗很可爱。喜欢热。

[来自[url=https://doksa.itch.io/bounty-or-booty]itch.io[/url]]
